title: cleaning semitary
summary: Members of our church community, including both our youth and seniors, came together to clean up the church cemetery.
description: On November 1, 2026, members of our church community gathered at Puthuval for a voluntary cleanup drive of the church cemetery. Volunteers across all generations—including both youth and seniors—worked together to clean and restore the grounds, reflecting a shared spirit of service, fellowship, and respect for our community.
